conceptZh: 玩具機器人拿著望遠鏡到處找星星，翻來翻去都找不到；其實有一顆小星星早就悄悄飄到他頭上坐好，還轉頭對鏡頭揮揮手，他卻完全沒發現，繼續認真地找。
object: a toy robot with a chunky telescope and one small star toy
morph: the glyph 星 stands still as a solid sculpture while the star quietly settles on the searching robot
creativeAngle: 接上太空與漫威英雄的想像，笑點是「找不到的東西就坐在自己頭上」的觀眾優越感，小星星對鏡頭揮手把孩子拉進笑點裡。星為日在上、生在下，兩個部件孩子都學過，正好互相連結。語音詞「火星」，火ㄏㄨㄛˇ已學過，兩字都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 星 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep violet, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 日 on top sits directly above the 生 below, both clearly separated, with all horizontal strokes evenly spaced. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Along its base stands a small boxy toy robot holding a chunky toy telescope far too large for him. From 0.6 seconds he sweeps it across the frame in a determined search, left, right, then straight up, then down at the ground, then back up, growing more and more thorough. At 1.8 seconds one small round star toy with a sleepy face drifts quietly down behind him and settles neatly on the flat top of his head, getting comfortable. The robot does not notice and keeps searching. At 2.8 seconds the star turns to the camera and gives a tiny wave. Hold that. At 3.6 seconds the robot lowers the telescope, scratches his head right next to the star without touching it, and sets off searching in the opposite direction, walking out of frame to the left by 4.6 seconds with the star still riding on top. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 星 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「星、星、火星」, using the reading ㄒㄧㄥ for 星 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 星 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 火星 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 星: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
